data.summary: As the Shooting phase of your opponent begins, pick one enemy INFANTRY unit this model can see that is 12" or less away, and roll a D6. A 1 means this model takes D3 mortal wounds. A 2-5 means attacks made by that unit's models get -1 to the Hit roll for the rest of the phase. A 6 means that unit cannot be chosen to shoot for the rest of the phase.
